$comment: Cache of resolved, known-stable elements. Written by the executor after a successful run - not hand-maintained, so the system gets faster on its own. A stale entry is never fatal: a miss falls through to live discovery and the entry is re-recorded. Delete this file at any time; the only cost is one slower run. 'hits'/'misses' are advisory - an entry with repeated misses is a renamed control worth looking at.
